name: Quantum Dice
description: Quantum Dice develops photonic quantum random number generators (QRNGs) and the ORBIT™ probabilistic processor, which uses quantum noise sources to accelerate combinatorial optimization and AI workloads. The company was spun out of the University of Oxford and is backed by IP Group. Quantum Dice received an EIC Accelerator grant in December 2025 and partnered with STFC's Hartree Centre.
funding: €2M EIC Accelerator grant (December 2025); backed by IP Group
